description.zh: 代理集群名称，可以通过控制台查看该代理集群名称。
description.en: The name of the proxy cluster. You can view the proxy cluster name in the console.

description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。
description.en: The page number of the current page when paging is used.

description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used.

description.zh: 代理节点uuid，可以通过接口DescribeHybridProxyList获取。
description.en: The UUID of the proxy node. You can call the DescribeHybridProxyList operation to obtain this value.

description.zh: 云安全中心客户端对应的唯一KEY，用户可以通过查询资产获取该机器已安装云安全中心客户端UUID信息。
description.en: The unique key of the Security Center agent. You can call an asset query operation to obtain the UUID of the Security Center agent installed on the server.
